business_summary: IK HOLDINGS Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the direct marketing and sales marketing businesses in Japan. The company sells general merchandise, and food products, as well as cosmetics through TV shopping, online and internet shopping, brick-and-mortar, and in physical stores. It also sells its cosmetic products under the hince, fillimilli, CAREPLUS, AROMATICA, BRAYE, klrairs, and SKINFOOD brands. In addition, the company operates wholesale business to consumer cooperatives, mail order companies, retail stores, overseas companies, and other organizations. IK HOLDINGS Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1982 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.
